scope: Audit and close the isolated cold-cache and warm-steady P9 protocol prerequisite

amdahl.W_C_O_s: not applicable to a protocol-only closure
amdahl.overlap_exclusions: cold and warm are separate workloads and are never averaged or treated as independent repetitions from one warming process
amdahl.strict_fallback: warm steady remains the benchmark default; isolated cold is diagnostic only

implementation.warm: one initial file-scoped WILLNEED for per_layer_token_embd.weight, then declared warmups followed by measured repetitions
implementation.cold: before every warmup and measured request, close/remap the PLE memmap and apply mapping plus file-scoped DONTNEED only to the 28,800,138,240-byte tensor range

decision: Close the protocol prerequisite without rerunning it. The existing implementation and retained artifact already prove isolated per-request cold eviction/remap, separate warm steady state, deterministic equal output, and zero teardown. The larger off/auto/on p512/p1024/p4096 economics matrix remains open.
